verdict.rationale: Extend positions itself as a platform for building document agents, with workflows and a Composer & Review Agent, so asking whether it can consume external MCP servers is a fair question. The pack documents the opposite role only: Extend exposes its own official MCP server for outside clients to connect to (docs/mcp, 'Connect from your client'). There is no evidence that Extend's workflows or agents can plug in third-party MCP servers and call their tools.
